name: last_successful_poll fresh while imap_connected (usable as liveness signal)
fix: In IDLE mode last_successful_poll only advances on EXISTS/fetch, so it goes arbitrarily stale on a healthy idle box. Stamp it on every IDLE keepalive/re-issue (or NOOP every few min) so staleness means 'broken'

name: 10 concurrent waits (5s) all return 408, none 500/hang

name: each 408 arrives close to requested timeout (5s +/- 3)
fix: Enforce the deadline around the initial scan() too (it currently sits outside asyncio.wait_for)

name: active_waiter_count returns to 0 after timeouts
fix: Always deregister in finally (it does) and make count reflect only live waiters

name: timeout_s=301 accepted (silently clamped) rather than rejected

fix: Spec says 'int<=300': reject >300 with 422 (le=300) instead of silently clamping, so clients learn their assumption is wrong

name: abandoned long waits (client gone after 8s) are released promptly
observed: count after disconnect=2; drained to 0 after 300.3s since request start (=> timeout_s clamp = 300s confirmed)
fix: Poll request.is_disconnected() (or use a Starlette background disconnect watcher) in the wait loop and cancel + deregister; otherwise an abandoned waiter keeps consuming OTP emails for ~5 min and the real retry gets nothing
